# 🛠️ STEAMIDRA — FIXING A GAME

Work down the list — **stop as soon as the game works.**

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 1️⃣ Try It Vanilla
Launch the game normally. Some games have no protection at all.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 2️⃣ Try `-onlinefix` (LC Online Fix)
1. In SteaMidra, pick the game from the dropdown → **Home tab → LC Online Fix**.
   -# Or in Steam: right-click the game → **Properties → Launch Options** → add `-onlinefix`
2. Launch it again.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 3️⃣ Use OnlineFixManager
Finds the right Online-Fix files for you, backs up your originals, and makes the fix a one-click toggle.
1. Download **`OnlineFixManager-Setup.exe`** from **[the releases page](https://github.com/j117mw3/OnlineFixManager/releases/latest)** and run it.
   -# It's unsigned — if Windows warns you, click **More info → Run anyway**.
2. In **Setup**: add your Steam libraries, pick Downloads/Backups folders, and **connect an Online-Fix session** (sign in to online-fix.me in the Edge window that opens).
3. Select your game → **Backup & Install Fix**.
4. Launch and test → hit **Confirm it works**.

**🔁 Toggling the fix**
- **Off** → **Restore Original Files**
- **On** → **Apply Saved Fix**
-# Extraction failing? Install [7-Zip](https://www.7-zip.org/). Downloads failing? Refresh the Online-Fix session in Setup. Never share its `config.json` — it holds your login.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🔒 Still Broken? It's Probably DRM
- **SteamStub DRM** → select the game in SteaMidra → **Remove SteamStub DRM**.
- **Other DRM / server-side auth** → search **[cs.rin.ru](https://cs.rin.ru/forum/)** for your game and grab a **crack-only** release (not a full repack).
